{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the `revenue` column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify and remove the six QA orders with revenue 999999.99
qa_mask = sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
qa_count = qa_mask.sum()
print("Number of QA orders (revenue == 999999.99):", qa_count)

# Remove QA orders
sales_clean = sales[~qa_mask]

# Count completed orders
completed_count = sales_clean['status'].value_counts().get('completed', 0)
print("Number of completed orders (after removing QA orders):", completed_count)

# Output the key numbers
qa_count, completed_count"}
